action:
command:MEM_START=$(echo $((0x$(echo "$HEAP_MEM" | cut -d"-" -f1))))
response:chris@speedlab-ml-3:~$

action:
command:MEM_STOP=$(echo $((0x$(echo "$HEAP_MEM" | cut -d"-" -f2))))
response:chris@speedlab-ml-3:~$

action:
command:MEM_SIZE=$(echo $((0x$MEM_STOP-0x$MEM_START)))
response:chris@speedlab-ml-3:~$
